info.name: Share Cleanup
info.summary: Deletes shares older than a configurable period, with tagging and advance notification
info.description:
# Share Cleanup
Automatically deletes **all shares** — internal and external — that are older than a configurable period (default: 365 days).
## Features
* Configurable maximum share age in days (default: **365**) * **Automatic system tag** on every shared file/folder at creation time, showing the date the share will be deleted (e.g. "Share-Cleanup: Löschung am 2027-08-15") * **Advance notification** to the sharing user when 90 % of the lifetime has passed (i.e. 10 % before deletion) * Shares that have their **own expiration date are never deleted** (and are never tagged) * Dry-run mode: only log what would be deleted * Manual execution via OCC command (`occ sharecleanup:run`) * Automatic execution via Nextcloud background job (hourly) * Admin settings page under Administration → Sharing
## Requirements
Nextcloud 33 or higher.
## Security note
Deletions are **irreversible**. The app starts in dry-run mode — test first.
